title: ONE US STATE
VS A WHOLE
COUNTRY
hook: One US state against a whole country. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each. The last one is wild!

qs.q: Which is bigger: California or Italy?
qs.fact: California is about 40% bigger than Italy.
qs.sayAnswer: California! It is about forty percent bigger than Italy.

qs.q: Which is bigger: Spain or Texas?
qs.fact: Texas is bigger than Spain and Portugal combined.
qs.sayAnswer: Texas! It is bigger than Spain and Portugal combined.

qs.q: Which is bigger: Montana or Germany?
qs.fact: Montana tops Germany, with 1.1 million people against 83 million.
qs.sayAnswer: Montana! It beats Germany, with just over one million people against eighty-three million.

qs.q: Which is bigger: UK or Wyoming?
qs.say: Which is bigger: the U K or Wyoming?
qs.fact: Wyoming is about 4% bigger than the UK, with under 600,000 people.
qs.sayAnswer: Wyoming! It is about four percent bigger than the United Kingdom, with fewer than six hundred thousand people.

qs.q: Which is the biggest: Peru, Alaska or South Africa?
qs.fact: Alaska beats Peru and South Africa, with under a million people.
qs.sayAnswer: Alaska! It is bigger than Peru, and bigger than South Africa, with fewer than one million people.
